title: FACET - Facet Aware Contrastive Embeddings for Traits- Big Five Estimation from Life Narratives
abstract: arXiv:2611.23560v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personality is only weakly and inconsistently signaled by written language, and existing text-based methods typically combine language-model and psycholinguistic representations at the input or decision level. It remains open whether a more deliberate combination of the two views, and a decomposition of the prediction target, can recover more of the signal. We present a three-phase framework for estimating Big Five personality domain scores from life-narrative interview text. It encodes text and psycholinguistic features separately and combines them by concatenation or by a learned weighting, decomposes each domain into contrastively trained facet embeddings instead of predicting the domain directly, and pools the facet embeddings by attention into a domain-level prediction. We compare end-to-end with staged training and ablate the input modalities, their combination, and the facet-pooling strategy. On 1,332 participants from the St. Lou

translated_title: FACET——面向特质维度的感知型对比嵌入：从生活叙事估计大五人格
translated_abstract: 人格仅能通过书面语言微弱且不一致地表达出来，现有的基于文本的方法通常在输入层或决策层将语言模型表征与心理语言学表征相结合。是否可以通过对两种视角更加审慎的组合以及对预测目标的分解来恢复更多的信号，这一问题仍悬而未决。我们提出了一个三阶段框架，用于从生活叙事访谈文本中估计大五人格领域分数。该框架分别编码文本特征和心理语言学特征，并通过拼接或学习得到的加权方式将其组合，将每个领域分解为经过对比训练的特质面嵌入，而非直接预测领域分数，并通过注意力机制将特质面嵌入汇聚为领域级预测。我们比较了端到端训练与分阶段训练的效果，并对输入模态、其组合方式以及特质面汇聚策略进行了消融实验。在来自圣路易斯（St. Lou...）的1,332名参与者上……
tldr: 该论文提出三阶段框架FACET，将大五人格各领域分解为对比训练的特质面嵌入并用注意力汇聚为领域预测，同时融合语言模型与心理语言学两种表征，从生活叙事文本中更充分地提取人格信号。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FACET, a three-phase framework that decomposes each Big Five domain into contrastively trained facet embeddings pooled by attention, deliberately combining language-model and psycholinguistic representations to recover more personality signal from life narratives.
